curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42121-1-1.pdf (one book, 120 pages; page 48 and the back cover, page 115, show the functions)

functions.does: The black gear knob at the back of the superstructure raises and lowers the boom: through a 20 tooth gear and a long shaft with two universal joints it turns the linear actuator under the boom, which pushes the boom up.
functions.source: book: page 48 (lower picture), back cover; actuator step 44, rear gears steps 59-66

functions.does: The black gear knob on the side of the superstructure opposite the cab moves the stick in and out: its shaft runs to a 20 tooth bevel gear at the foot of the boom, which turns a 12 tooth bevel and a shaft with universal joints up the boom to the linear actuator inside it.
functions.source: book: page 48 (upper picture), back cover; actuator step 21, shaft and bevel gear steps 3, 15 and 35
functions.note: the 12 tooth bevel rides round the 20 tooth one as the boom swings, so raising the boom may move the stick a little

functions.does: The whole superstructure, with cab, boom and stick, slews all the way round on the turntable above the tracks, by hand.
functions.source: book: back cover (360 degrees); turntable step 85

functions.does: The two tracks roll freely round their sprockets and rollers; nothing drives them.
The bucket is fixed to the end of the stick; the grey cylinder on the stick is only for show.
functions.source: book: stick steps 27-30 (a 3 long beam pins the bucket on)
